notes: SSH is rarely exploitable directly; research focuses on auth configuration, exposed key material found elsewhere, and version-specific CVEs. Never run password brute-force.

checks.title: Permitted authentication methods
checks.validation: Enumerate offered auth methods (publickey/password/keyboard-interactive) non-invasively; password auth widens the attack surface.

checks.title: Weak or legacy algorithms offered
checks.validation: List algorithms (e.g. nmap ssh2-enum-algos) and compare against current hardening guidance.

checks.title: Reusable key material discovered elsewhere
checks.when: an id_rsa / authorized_keys was found via another service
checks.validation: Attempt key-based login once, with approval and within scope.
